shots.quest: Photograph your own shadow on the road or a wall.

verdict.observation: The image shows a human shadow cast upon a cracked concrete surface with patches of green moss.
verdict.title: Shadow on Concrete
verdict.field_note: The moss growth is quite extensive, suggesting a consistently damp environment – I'd like to investigate the drainage patterns in this area to see what’s contributing to the moisture.

shots.quest: Photograph a leaf from a street tree, up close.

verdict.observation: The photo shows a papayas tree growing against a brick wall with a hazy background.
verdict.title: Papaya Leaf Detail
verdict.field_note: The leaf shape is quite distinctive, with its deeply lobed edges – I’d be keen to examine the venation pattern more closely next time to further identify the species. The light is a bit flat today, which makes it difficult to discern subtle color variations in the foliage.

shots.quest: Find a fallen leaf lying on the road or the pavement.

verdict.observation: This photo shows a patch of low-growing plants growing along a reddish-brown wall adjacent to a gravelly area.
verdict.title: Weedy Wall Growth
verdict.field_note: The plants are quite robust and appear to be thriving in this exposed location—it’s interesting to see how they’ve adapted to the harsh conditions. I'd like to note if I saw any fallen leaves nearby when I revisit this spot.

shots.quest: Find a weed growing in a crack in the pavement or a wall.

verdict.observation: The photo shows a clump of grass growing in a narrow crack between a brick wall and a paved surface.
verdict.title: Pavement Grass Seedling
verdict.field_note: The grass is thriving in the sheltered space created by the brick, suggesting a preference for slightly cooler, shaded conditions. I’ll be interested to observe how it develops over time and if it manages to establish itself further.
